desc: 钴蓝临床详情页，犬猫铋剂护膜止泻片，十一镜从机理到收口
leaf: 犬猫内用碱式碳酸铋片（透明圆肩瓶＋白色竖纹旋盖＋蓝色环绕标贴＋朱红片剂）
name: 犬猫铋剂护膜止泻片款

shots.intent: 首屏用钴蓝渐变临床版面与圆肩瓶同台拿下停留，一秒建立犬猫内用止泻片剂的剂型认知
shots.textZone: 顶部两行主标题带（白色）配一行 kicker 与一条朱红短线，其下左侧一行副标位

shots.intent: 用三格日常肠胃不适现象让犬猫主人立刻对号入座，把软便、呕吐与精神差的摩擦放大成解决需求
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题带与一行胶囊副标位，三卡下方各一枚实色标签条文字位

shots.intent: 把四条作用链条拆成图标加实色胶囊条的索引带，让买家在下滑三秒内读完产品怎么起作用
shots.textZone: 顶部两行主标题带（深蓝），其下四条胶囊条各一枚主张位并各配一枚圆形图标

shots.intent: 用一章编号加柔白胃形剪影与三枚勾选气泡，把表面防护这一抽象机制讲成看得见的画面
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题带与三行短句说明位，三枚气泡内各一行短标签位

shots.intent: 第二章用两台同型瓶在暖金台座上仰立，把机制章节转成产品气势与信任感
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题带与两行短句说明位，其下不另置文字

shots.intent: 用第三章的胃与肠回路剪影加节点圆片，把作用路径走成一条可跟读的动线
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题带与两行短句说明位，节点内不排任何文字

shots.intent: 给出可信的日常在家喂药时点，让买家想象自己在家给宠物喂片剂的真实时刻
shots.textZone: 左上主标题带与一行短句位，其下一枚胶囊标签位

shots.intent: 微距呈现竖纹旋盖、瓶肩通透感与瓶内朱红片剂实貌，用可见封装与内容物替代口头质量承诺
用干净的深蓝信息卡一次答完名称、性状、对象与保存疑虑，省掉买家追问客服
shots.textZone: 卡头主标题位与一行副标位，卡内六行字段标签配占位值

shots.intent: 把买家最关心的按体重分档与频次决策一次答完，用中性占位表代替源图数字避免误导
shots.textZone: 卡头主标题位，四列各一枚列标签位，卡下一行提示位与一枚勾选短语位

shots.intent: 收口回到首屏同一钴蓝盾面，把护膜止泻的安心感收成一个低摩擦下单动作
shots.textZone: 上半区主标题带与一行副标题位，下方圆角胶囊按钮位

style.backgroundSystem: two linked systems held to one language: cobalt gradient clinical screens #1F63CE deepening to navy #123C8A at the base and opening to a bright sky-blue end #7FB2EF at the top, each lit by one soft vertical light shaft, backed at one side by a brushed light-grey pegboard panel #D9DDE2 carrying a dot matrix of recessed discs, with one translucent glass shield outline floating behind the product — used for the opening hero, the two chapter screens and the close; and flat cold-grey #E9EBEE or clean #FFFFFF infographic screens carrying solid cobalt capsule bars and white rounded cards with 24px corners — used for every list, table and diagram screen; never a third background language
style.direction: cobalt clinical-mechanism pet tablet detail-page commerce
style.iconSystem: single-family solid cobalt circular tokens #1F63CE each holding one white single-weight glyph at one stroke weight, paired one-to-one with a solid cobalt capsule bar carrying white copy; soft translucent white organ-glow silhouettes of a stomach and an intestinal loop as the recurring diagram motif, laid over one faint shield outline; white tick bubbles #FFFFFF ringed once in #1F63CE holding one deep-blue label each; shield-shaped outline number chips carrying one plain digit; one recurring hairline rule in #123C8A as the section divider; no realistic microbe, blood, pain-star or cartoon-virus illustrations, no seals, medals, ribbons, stamps or authority badges
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key clinical light from the front-top at 6000K with a large bounce fill, low-contrast soft gradients across the blue field, one controlled matte specular running down the clear bottle shoulder and along the white ribbed screw cap, soft contact shadows under every object so nothing floats; the single home scene uses natural window light from the left at 5200K with soft shadows falling to the right
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cobalt clinical-mechanism pet tablet ecommerce visual system across the entire detail-page image set; fixed palette of cobalt panel #1F63CE deepening to navy #123C8A with one bright sky-blue gradient end #7FB2EF, cold-grey field #E9EBEE and card field #FFFFFF, one crimson tablet accent #C02030, one warm gold podium ring #F2B45C and one palm-frond green prop accent #4E8F52; cool tone; modern geometric heavy-weight sans-serif Chinese with one headline weight per screen, headlines in #FFFFFF on cobalt fields and in #123C8A on grey and white fields, capsule-bar labels at 16-20pt and one short crimson underline tick #C02030 beneath each hero headline; background system alternating cobalt gradient clinical screens lit by one soft vertical light shaft and backed by a brushed light-grey pegboard panel #D9DDE2 carrying a recessed dot matrix with one translucent glass shield outline floating behind the product, and flat cold-grey #E9EBEE or clean #FFFFFF infographic screens carrying solid cobalt capsule bars and white rounded cards with 24px corner radius; bright even high-key clinical light from the front-top at 6000K with a large bounce fill, low-contrast soft gradients, one controlled matte specular down the clear bottle shoulder and the white ribbed cap, soft contact shadows under every object so nothing floats, natural window light at 5200K in the single home scene; surfaces of glossy cobalt cylinder podium #1F63CE ringed once in warm gold #F2B45C over a brushed light-grey floor #D9DDE2, a matte navy plinth #123C8A and one matte pale-stone home counter #EDEAE5; single-family solid cobalt circular icon tokens holding one white single-weight glyph each and paired one-to-one with solid cobalt capsule bars, soft translucent white organ-glow silhouettes laid over one faint shield outline, white tick bubbles ringed once in #1F63CE and shield-shaped outline number chips carrying one plain digit; the clear round-shoulder bottle with its white ribbed screw cap, blue wrap-around label block and crimson tablets visible through the wall held at the same slight 3/4 hero angle and the same scale on every screen; cats and dogs always cropped above the shoulders or turned away so no individual animal reads as identifiable; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no numeric dose, volume, strength, pack-count or shelf-life values in rendered copy, no fabricated certifications, seals, laboratory numbers or blank certificate frames, no invented veterinary endorsement, no QR codes or store patches.
noDrift: no ingredient, dosage, volume, strength, pack-count, shelf-life or onset-time values in rendered copy
no fabricated certification, inspection report, laboratory number, seal, stamp or blank certificate frame
no invented veterinary endorsement, clinic, doctor or pharmacist figure
no realistic parasite, blood, vomit or faeces depiction
no breed-identifiable animal or invented breed claim
no QR codes, membership stickers, store patches, barcodes or contact details
no tropical foliage beyond the two fixed palm-frond edges
no flat single-tone blue field replacing the locked vertical gradient
style.presentationRules: the clear round-shoulder bottle with its white ribbed screw cap, blue wrap-around label block and the crimson tablets visible through the wall is held at the same slight 3/4 hero angle and the same scale on every screen, grounded by a soft contact shadow, its cap ribs, shoulder curve, label placement and tablet fill level true to the reference and never restyled; where a second unit appears it is the identical unit at identical scale, never an invented size; cats and dogs always cropped above the shoulders or turned away so no individual animal reads as identifiable; card corners fixed at 24px; blue fields always read as a vertical gradient, never flat
style.surfaceSystem: glossy cobalt cylinder podium #1F63CE ringed once in warm gold #F2B45C over a brushed light-grey floor #D9DDE2, matte navy plinth #123C8A on the chapter screens, and one matte pale-stone home counter #EDEAE5 in the single home scene
style.typography: modern geometric heavy-weight sans-serif Chinese with one headline weight per screen; headlines in #FFFFFF on cobalt gradient fields and in #123C8A on cold-grey and white fields, capsule-bar labels 16-20pt, table and spec-row labels 16pt, one short crimson underline tick #C02030 beneath each hero headline, one letter-spaced latin kicker line above the opening headline; every rendered line is carried as a 「」 placeholder, never as source copy
